title: Penniston's 'sphere of influence' near the Rendlesham craft

tellings.quote: in and around this uh what Jim penniston called a sphere of influence where he felt like he was walking through water

plain: In 1980, during a reported encounter with an unknown craft in Rendlesham Forest in England, an American airman named Jim Penniston said the area around the object was "a sphere of influence" where he felt like he was "walking through water." The researcher Mike Masters repeats Penniston's description to Michels, without naming where it comes from. To Masters it suggests the craft changed the space around it, which fits his idea that such visitors may be humans from the future.
